leadText:
Bulbasaur (Japanese: ダネリーナ Danerina) is a female belonging to Pistachio in Magical Pokémon Journey. She has a crush on Pistachio and becomes jealous when he is seen talking to other females.

While Bulbasaur has a nickname in Japanese, she was not given one in the English translations of the manga. In the Pokémon File at the end of , she is identified as "Bulba", but in all of the manga chapters, she is simply named "Bulbasaur".
